title: Cell type-specific mRNA purification by translating ribosome affinity purification (TRAP)
boundary: Cell-type restricted tagged ribosomes are affinity captured with their intact associated mRNAs before downstream RNA profiling. This is distinct from nuclease-footprint Ribo-seq and chemical RiboLace capture. Species, epitope and downstream kit substitutions must not become extra protocols; RiboTag remains a comparison, not a separate admission.

title: Barcoded oligonucleotides ligated on RNA amplified for multiplexed and parallel in situ analyses

title: Expansion sequencing: Spatially precise in situ transcriptomics in intact biological systems
